caption_used: Sparsity ratio of SDPA output across layers under the 1e-2 threshold, comparing three gating configurations. The sparsity ratio before gate (blue dashed, avg 0.03) begins at approximately 0.2 and declines steadily to near zero by layer 5, remaining flat thereafter. The sparsity ratio after gate (orange dotted, avg 0.44) starts at 1.0 and decreases sharply, converging with the after-average-gate line near 0.15 by layer 10 before both stabilize. Notably, the after-average-gate configuration (green dash-dot, avg 0.33) consistently maintains higher sparsity than the after-gate line across all layers beyond the initial decline, with the two lines never intersecting after layer 5. The before-gate configuration demonstrates that pre-gating hidden states exhibit minimal sparsity throughout the network.

raw_responses.Chinese:
The figure displays a comparison of sparsity ratios derived from SDPA output across different layers of a network, under a threshold of 1e-2, illustrating the effect of different gating configurations. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to approximately 20, with evenly spaced intervals of 2 units. The y-axis represents the sparsity ratio, ranging from approximately 0 to 1, with increments of 0.05. The blue dashed line, labeled “sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03,” is a dashed line with no markers, starting at a value of approximately 0.2 at layer 0 and decreasing to approximately 0.02 at layer 5, remaining relatively constant thereafter. The orange dotted line, labeled “sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44,” is a dotted line with no markers, beginning at a value of 1.0 at layer 0 and decreasing to approximately 0.15 at layer 10, then stabilizing. The green dash-dot line, labeled “sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33,” is a dash-dot line with no markers, starting at a value of approximately 0.33 at layer 0, decreasing to approximately 0.08 at layer 5, and then increasing to approximately 0.31 at layer 20, consistently maintaining a higher sparsity ratio than the orange dotted line after layer 5.
